scope: The 15 listed final gameplay/title PNGs and two separately listed original-art contact sheets were opened with view_image. Final screenshots were independently inspected as raw RGB PNGs. Existing Native audit and common run/title-layout JSON were read. No new browser, GPU, product-code changes or test runs were performed for this review.
conclusion: No blocking visual defect found in the 15 reviewed final screenshots.
observations: The current posture is readable as 서기 -> 웅크림 -> 서기 with the actual Alt+C key hint. The selected crouch button and upper crouch status badge agree, and the actual crouched player body is visibly lower than the standing body.
Javelin hotbar counts visibly change 1 -> 0 -> 1 across held, thrown and recovered states. The thrown original art and recovered bag item remain distinct, while the empty hand uses 주먹 attack mode.

The original reaver1 corpse is visible in final Native images; its rust-red masked walk/attack contact sheet was also opened. Existing scene illumination keeps the living target dark and was not changed for this review.

At 1366x768 the left reaction/posture controls, right attack mode, ten hotbar slots and lower maneuver buttons fit without overlap or viewport clipping. Inventory remains readable and within the viewport.

Both common title layouts retain original art and a fully visible start button at scroll zero. Recorded start bottoms are 880.28125 at 1440x1080 and 714.28125 at 1366x768; both recorded center hit tests are true.
Some view_image previews omit portions of panels, but raw RGB pixels retain status, tools, needs, inventory and log. Those preview omissions are not classified as product defects.

This is a visual and artifact review. Zero-TU posture semantics, exact two-turn/one-turn movement, item UID identity and whole-world/save behavior are covered by the separate existing Native comparisons, not inferred solely from screenshots.

raw_png_check.method: For each non-title screenshot, count RGB pixels with max(channel) > 36 in fixed panel regions. Supporting evidence distinguishes preview omissions from original PNG pixels; it is not a semantic UI test.
raw_png_check.note: Status includes the adjacent body silhouette. The inventory region may contain world pixels while the inventory is closed. Title/contact sheets have no panel-region counts.
